summary: Build practical skills in PPP risk allocation, KPI design, payment mechanisms, and contract management. Enrol in this five-day course.
lede: Performance-based infrastructure contracts and PPP operations training helps you turn service expectations into clear, enforceable obligations for availability, quality, safety, maintenance, and user-service outcomes. You will learn to align risk allocation, output specifications, KPIs, payment triggers, change control, and dispute escalation within a coherent contract model. Through practical exercises, you will build a risk allocation matrix, create output-linked indicators, model deductions and incentives in Excel, and develop a contract governance calendar. The course also covers FIDIC structures, the World Bank PPP Reference Guide, ISO 31000, procurement alignment, lender reporting, and a practical implementation roadmap.
audienceIntro: Performance-based contracts training suits professionals who shape, procure, administer, monitor, or advise infrastructure arrangements where payment depends on measurable service delivery. It supports beginner-to-intermediate practitioners who can connect their existing sector experience to structured PPP and contract-management methods.
prerequisites: Working knowledge of infrastructure projects, public procurement, utilities, construction, operations and maintenance, or contract administration is recommended. No coding or programming is required. You should bring familiarity with your organization’s procurement stages, contract records, or service-level obligations where possible. Advanced digital monitoring and payment modelling are taught at operational application level, using spreadsheet templates and dashboard concepts rather than production-system implementation.
